tiles.title: 바이옴 타일
tiles.desc: 바닥 32×32(이어 붙여도 이음새 없음), 벽 32×48(윗면 + 앞면).

tiles.title: 자동타일 · 이끼 묘지
tiles.desc: N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8 비트마스크 → wall_XX. bit is set when the neighbour in that direction is a wall cell (wall, doorway_h, or out of map). index = N|E|S|W -> wall_%02d.png

items.note: isolated pillar — front face visible; open/edge on N,E,S,W
south end (front) — front face visible; open/edge on E,S,W
west end cap — front face visible; open/edge on N,S,W
outer corner SW — front face visible; open/edge on S,W
north end (top only) — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on N,E,W
vertical run — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on E,W
outer corner NW (top-left) — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on N,W
T junction open W — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on W
east end cap — front face visible; open/edge on N,E,S
outer corner SE — front face visible; open/edge on E,S
horizontal run (straight front) — front face visible; open/edge on N,S
T junction open S (T down-front) — front face visible; open/edge on S
outer corner NE (top-right) — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on N,E
T junction open E — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on E
T junction open N — top only (wall continues south); open/edge on N
cross / interior — top only (wall continues south)
